registration_note: Each collector registers once at construction and once at simulator reset; only 16 episodes have executed actions, not 32 rollouts.
media_findings: Three camera streams decode; task and instance scenes correspond to the recorded metadata, with real temporal changes.
Navigation wrist views frequently show robot-body occlusion; these are not missing or artificially black frames.
make_pizza and sorting_vegetables have different NAVIGATE/GRASP intents in their two slots at frame 640, consistent with independent planner ledgers.
Many samples remain in navigation; close-up grasp imagery alone does not establish grasp success or recovery success.
limitations: CPU tests and two real updates establish engineering correctness, not policy effectiveness.
Synchronous rollout is limited by the slowest simulator; observed cooking-task throughput is lower than other first tasks.
Active communication_seconds uses a CPU timer without explicit CUDA synchronization; do not interpret it as GPU transfer wall time.
Low-level PPO sampling and recomputation remain batch1; high-level planning is batched. Public evaluation remains cancelled.
Independent team code review is still pending; no merge into main.
